extension.description: Browse and read Xiaohongshu notes from Visual Studio Code.
settings.browserMode.description: Browser mode. Defaults to headless mode without a visible window. Reload the VS Code window after changing this setting.
settings.browserMode.headless: Run without a visible browser window. Login and content browsing share the same session.
settings.browserMode.window: Use windowed Chromium, which requires a graphical desktop. Windows may appear, move, or take focus during startup or navigation. Automatic minimization may fail and affect your experience.
commands.refreshLoginQr: xiaohongshu-fisher: Refresh Xiaohongshu Login QR Code
